svg.title: 3D surface plot: z equals e to the power, negative open paren x squared plus y squared close paren divided by 4, end exponent cosine of open paren x y divided by 2 close paren
svg.desc: 3D surface plot titled “z equals e to the power, negative open paren x squared plus y squared close paren divided by 4, end exponent cosine of open paren x y divided by 2 close paren”. x axis “x”, from -3 to 3. y axis “y”, from -3 to 3. z axis, from -0.065 to 1. Colors stand for values from -0.065 to 1. z = exp(-(x^2+y^2)/4)*cos(deg(x*y/2)), for x from -3 to 3 and y from -3 to 3; z is lowest, -0.065, at x = -2.25, y = -2.25, and highest, 1, at x = 0, y = 0.
